note: No real business, person or price is shown. The bakery is a HYPOTHETICAL (called out in the voiceover 'Let's say', the HYPOTHETICAL stamp and ILLUSTRATIVE FIGURES labels). Arithmetic checked: 15 L x 3 = 45 L; 15 L - 6 L (head baker salary) = 9 L; 9 L x 3 = 27 L; 1 Cr = 100 L. The 3x multiple is the script's own illustration, not a market claim. Source: Aryan's script (WhatsApp, 2026-11-05).

strings.text: You can buy a business making one crore rupees a year, for just twenty seven lakh. Let me explain.
Let's say there's a bakery. It makes one crore a year in sales. One day, the owner says he's selling.
You think, okay, one crore business, so I need one crore to buy it. Wrong.
That one crore isn't what he takes home. Staff, ingredients, rent, electricity. After all of it, the bakery keeps fifteen lakh a year in operating profit.
Here's the thing. You're not buying sales. You're buying its ability to make money. Pay three times that profit, and it's forty five lakh.
A one crore bakery for forty five lakh. Sounds like a steal. Well, not so fast.
What if the owner is the head baker? The moment he leaves, you hire someone for six lakh a year.
Now fifteen lakh of profit becomes nine. Same three times, and your forty five lakh drops to twenty seven.
Same bakery. Same one crore in sales. A completely different price.
So the real question isn't how much it sells. It's how much it will make after you take over.
Save this reel. And if you'd rather buy than build, DM LORE.
